## Checks

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Built with `./build.command`, added the thing in OBS, and moved **every** slider
- [ ] Ran the self-test and **looked at the pictures** — almost every bug in this
      repository was found by looking at a rendered frame, not by reading the code
      that drew it
- [ ] Any new setting is in `site/content.mjs`, and `make skill` has been run

## The two rules

- [ ] No code, markup, class names or file structure from a commercial theme or design system
- [ ] No trademarked logos — the marks in `glyph.effect` are generic on purpose
